title: 深豎井襯砌施工~Deep-shaft lining construction
focus: 深井環向受力、水壓回復與分段襯砌接縫~Deep-shaft ring action, groundwater recovery and staged lining joints
summary: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。~Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring.

units.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證~Effective stress mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。有效應力決定摩擦強度及變形，水壓另對不透水襯砌施力；因此從總應力扣去孔壓後，不能在襯砌設計中再把水力作用刪除。施工抽水與長期回復需分成不同階段，並核對應力方向及量測深度是否一致。~Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. Effective stress controls frictional strength and deformation while water pressure also acts on an impermeable lining. Subtracting pore pressure from total stress therefore does not eliminate hydraulic loading on the lining. Temporary drawdown and long-term recovery require separate stages, with consistent stress directions and measurement depths.
units.model: 原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。以地層參數及施工階段推估骨架應力，分別保留總應力與有效應力欄，避免同名數值混用。~Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops. Infer skeleton stress using ground parameters and construction stage, retaining separate total and effective stress columns to prevent substitution.
units.failure: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。水位回升而井內仍乾燥時，壓差會增大，排水暢通的施工觀察不足以證明永久水密安全。~Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Rising external water levels increase differential pressure around a dry shaft; successful construction drainage does not establish permanent watertightness.
units.misconception: 抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。~A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
units.practice: 設計圖應同時列出施工低水位、設計高水位與排水失效情境；襯砌封閉前，由地工與結構設計者共同確認各階段採用的水壓邊界。~Show construction drawdown, design high water and drainage failure on the design basis; before lining closure, the geotechnical and structural designers must jointly confirm hydraulic boundaries for each stage.

units.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證~Hoop compression mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 圓形襯砌可把近似均勻徑向外壓轉成環向壓力，這是圓井結構效率的來源。薄環模型假設厚度相對半徑小、斷面圓整且受壓連續；局部井口、設備孔洞或不均勻岩壓會破壞此假設。環向壓力只能描述平均膜力，不能替代偏心、裂縫、接縫轉動與局部彎矩的檢查。~A circular lining converts approximately uniform radial pressure into hoop compression, explaining the efficiency of a round shaft. The thin-ring model assumes a relatively small thickness, a circular section and continuous compression. Openings, penetrations and nonuniform rock loading violate these assumptions. Hoop force describes average membrane action, but it cannot replace checks of eccentricity, cracking, joint rotation or local bending where the load path is interrupted.
units.model: 原創教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa；本厚徑比須再以厚壁或數值模型檢查。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa; this thickness ratio also requires a thick-wall or numerical check. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。~Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis. Use paired strain gauges across openings and geological transitions; differences between inner and outer surface readings distinguish increasing local bending from average membrane compression.
units.failure: 偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。裂縫集中於開口角隅時，應追查力流中斷，不能只靠提高混凝土抗壓強度處理。~Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress. Cracks concentrated at opening corners indicate interrupted load paths that stronger concrete alone will not resolve.
units.misconception: 平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。~A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
units.practice: 將圓整度偏差、洞口加勁與背填驗收列為同一設計檢查；任何設備開孔變更，須經結構設計者確認環向力如何繞過開口後才施工。~Review ovality tolerances, opening reinforcement and backfill acceptance together; any revised service penetration requires the structural designer to confirm how hoop force bypasses the opening before construction.

units.title: 厚壁內緣的機理與驗證~Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 襯砌較厚時，環向應力沿半徑並不均勻；以整個厚度平均值評估內緣會漏掉應力集中。拉梅解把內外表面的徑向壓力邊界同時納入，適用於均質彈性圓筒的軸對稱狀態。分塊接縫、開裂及非均勻地層作用會改變剛度與接觸，須另用含接縫的模型判讀，不能把解析解當成完整承載能力。~In a thick lining, hoop stress varies across the radius, so an average stress can miss the inner-face concentration. The Lamé solution enforces radial-pressure boundaries at both surfaces and applies to a homogeneous elastic cylinder under axisymmetric loading. Segment joints, cracking and uneven ground alter stiffness and contact. They require separate joint-sensitive analysis; the elastic solution estimates a stress distribution rather than a complete structural resistance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：內半徑 a=4 m、外半徑 b=5 m、均勻外壓 p=0.4 MPa且內壓為零，σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa，負號代表受壓。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For a=4 m, b=5 m, external p=0.4 MPa and zero internal pressure, σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa, with compression negative. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 先以內外半徑及壓力邊界重算解析解，再用軸對稱模型查網格收斂；對開口附近另建局部模型。把不同位置的應變量測換成同一溫度基準，核對徑向分布是否符合完整接觸假設。~Recalculate the analytical solution from measured radii and boundary pressures, then check mesh convergence in an axisymmetric model and model openings separately. Temperature-correct strain readings at different radii and compare their distribution with the assumed continuous contact.
units.failure: 將外徑誤當半徑或忽略內壓，會使厚壁應力分布與實際邊界不符。若接縫張開仍沿用連續圓筒解，局部壓碎及滲水可能被平滑的平均結果掩蓋。~Using diameter as radius or omitting internal pressure corrupts the boundary solution. Continuing to assume a continuous cylinder after joints open can conceal local crushing and leakage behind a smooth average stress distribution.
units.misconception: 厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。~Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder.
units.practice: 計算書應標出壓力正負號、內外半徑及接觸範圍；以解析解校驗數值模型後，才由結構設計者核准加入孔洞和接縫的工程模型。~Label pressure signs, radii and contact extent in the calculation; use the analytical solution to verify the numerical model before the structural designer approves the engineering model with openings and joints.

units.title: 分段自重的機理與驗證~Lift self-weight mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 每一段新澆襯砌的自重先經施工接縫、支承環或臨時支承傳遞，不能假設未達強度的下段立刻承擔全部重量。粗糙接面可提供摩擦與剪力傳遞，但其能力與法向壓力、鋼筋連續性及施工品質有關。井壁與岩面若存在滑移或脫空，自重分配也會改變，施工階段的支承路徑因此必須單獨畫出。~Each new lining lift transfers its weight through construction joints, support rings or temporary supports; the immature lift below cannot automatically carry the full weight. Roughened interfaces transmit friction and shear according to normal pressure, reinforcement continuity and workmanship. Slip or separation against the rock changes the weight distribution. A separate construction-stage load-path diagram is therefore needed instead of assuming that the completed shaft's support system already exists.
units.model: 原創教學假設：混凝土單位重 γ=24 kN/m³、內外半徑4與4.5 m、段高 h=3 m，自重 W=γπ(4.5²−4²)h=961 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For γ=24 kN/m³, radii 4 and 4.5 m and lift height h=3 m, W=γπ(4.5²−4²)h=961 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以澆置體積、實際段高與材料密度核對自重，檢查支承環標高及接縫面。拆除臨時支承前，將同養護試體強度與支承反力量測對照施工分析，確認下一段的荷載已有可靠傳遞路徑。~Check weight from placed volume, actual lift height and material density, and inspect support-ring elevations and joint surfaces. Before temporary support removal, compare companion-cured strength and measured reactions with stage analysis to confirm a reliable path for the next lift.
units.failure: 新澆段提前加載可能使施工縫滑移或局部壓碎，留下環狀裂縫與不均勻沉降。這種損傷未必由最終使用荷載控制，完工後補算整體強度無法消除早期裂縫。~Premature loading of a new lift can cause joint slip or local crushing, leaving circumferential cracking and differential settlement. The governing event may be an early construction stage; a satisfactory final-state strength calculation does not remove that damage.
units.misconception: 最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。~Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage.
units.practice: 每一施工段交接須保存材料齡期、接面處理與支承移除紀錄；臨時工程設計者應簽認拆撐停留點，避免下一段施工自動成為放行依據。~Record material age, interface preparation and support-removal evidence for each lift; the temporary-works designer must release the removal hold point rather than allowing the next construction activity to imply approval.

units.title: 施工縫止水的機理與驗證~Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 止水帶的作用是延長或封閉接縫滲流路徑，效果同時取決於埋設位置、連續接合及兩側混凝土密實度。外部水頭提高時，微小缺口也可能成為集中滲漏路徑。接縫張開、錯位與材料老化會影響止水能力，故不能把混凝土本體抗滲結果直接當作施工縫性能，必須把位移與水壓共同納入試驗邊界。~A waterstop lengthens or closes the seepage path through a joint, but performance depends on embedment, continuity and concrete consolidation on both sides. A small defect can concentrate leakage as external head rises. Joint opening, offset and ageing also affect sealing. Concrete permeability alone therefore does not establish joint performance; displacement and water pressure must be imposed together when defining a representative qualification test.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密設計教學水頭 h=60 m、水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For teaching head h=60 m, water density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s², p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 檢查止水帶接頭連續性、固定位置與澆置後的蜂窩區；以代表性接縫試體在指定開口與錯位下施加水壓。比較滲漏量與專案訂定標準，並記錄升降壓循環後是否留下永久變形。~Inspect splice continuity, restraint position and honeycombing. Test a representative joint under specified opening and offset while applying water pressure; compare leakage with project criteria and record permanent deformation after pressure cycles rather than testing an undeformed strip alone.
units.failure: 止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。只在內表面封堵可能使水改走另一弱面，並掩蓋持續外水壓。~Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. Surface sealing alone may divert flow to another weak interface and conceal sustained external water pressure.
units.misconception: 止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。~A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint.
units.practice: 將接頭照片、材料批號與接縫位移需求綁定同一位置編碼；封模前由監造確認止水連續性，缺陷處理須經設計者核准而非只增塗表面材料。~Link splice photographs, material batch and required joint movement to one location code; inspection must confirm continuity before form closure, and the designer must approve defect repair rather than relying on added surface coating.

units.title: 早齡期溫差的機理與驗證~Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 水化熱提高厚襯砌核心溫度，後續降溫卻受到先澆段及岩面的拘束，於是自由收縮轉變為拉應力。材料在早齡期的彈性模數、抗拉強度與潛變都隨時間改變，完全拘束的彈性式僅提供上限量級。把溫差與齡期分開看會漏掉最弱時刻，因此須同時記錄溫度歷程、養護條件及接縫拘束。~Hydration heats the lining core, but subsequent cooling is restrained by earlier lifts and the rock, converting free contraction into tension. Elastic modulus, tensile strength and creep all change at early age, so a fully restrained elastic expression is only a bounding scale. Temperature difference cannot be assessed independently of material age: the weakest stage requires simultaneous temperature histories, curing conditions and realistic joint restraint rather than a final concrete strength alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa；未含潛變鬆弛。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa; creep relaxation is excluded. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 在核心、內表面及先澆接面布置溫度計，同步紀錄澆置與拆模時間；將最高溫及冷卻速率輸入齡期分析，並以材料試驗校正早期強度。裂縫巡查應比對溫降時刻，不只看最後寬度。~Instrument the core, inner surface and previous-lift interface and synchronize placement and form-removal times. Use peak temperature and cooling rate in age-dependent analysis, calibrating early strength with tests; relate crack inspections to cooling events rather than final width alone.
units.failure: 過快表面降溫或強拘束會產生貫穿裂縫，之後外水壓沿裂縫作用。若只把裂縫當成一般乾縮，忽略水化熱時程，後續各施工段可能重複出現相同損傷。~Rapid surface cooling or strong restraint can cause through-cracks that later admit pressurized water. Misclassifying these as ordinary drying shrinkage and ignoring the hydration history can reproduce the same damage in subsequent lining lifts.
units.misconception: 降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。~Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking.
units.practice: 溫控計畫應列出材料齡期、拘束假設及觀測位置；拆模與養護調整由材料及結構負責人共同核定，不能用單支表面溫度計取代核心紀錄。~The thermal-control plan must include material age, restraint assumptions and observation positions; materials and structural leads jointly authorize form-removal and curing changes, and one surface thermometer cannot replace core records.

units.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證~Backfill void mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。局部襯砌此時近似跨越缺口的板帶，彎曲需求隨未支承長度平方增長。簡支梁只是診斷用量級，真實曲率、軸向壓力與兩側彈性支承會改變結果，灌漿壓力本身也可能額外推動襯砌。~Backfill establishes contact between the ground and lining; a void concentrates formerly distributed radial loading near its edges. The local lining behaves partly like a strip spanning a gap, with bending increasing approximately with the square of unsupported length. A simply supported beam is a diagnostic scale only: curvature, hoop compression and elastic end restraint change the response, while backfill pressure can itself impose additional lining movement.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。將疑似空隙長度與裂縫位置疊圖，再比較補填前後的應變及接觸狀況，確認力流已恢復。~Locate voids using backfill-volume balance, acoustic methods and justified verification holes rather than grout consumption alone. Overlay suspected void length and cracking, then compare strain and contact evidence before and after remedial filling to verify restoration of the load path.
units.failure: 空隙兩端可能先出現彎曲裂縫，過高補漿壓力又可能把裂縫撐大。若耗漿量異常卻沒有追查去向，漿液可能流入裂隙而未填足目標接觸區。~Bending cracks can develop at void edges, while excessive remedial grouting pressure may widen them. Unexplained high grout consumption can mean loss into rock fractures rather than successful filling of the intended contact zone.
units.misconception: 灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。~More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact.
units.practice: 背填驗收應以可證明的接觸範圍及結構反應為主；異常耗漿或襯砌位移須觸發停留點，由地工與襯砌設計者共同審查補填方案。~Base backfill acceptance on demonstrable contact extent and structural response; abnormal grout consumption or lining movement triggers a hold point for joint review by the geotechnical and lining designers.

units.title: 鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證~Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 保護層隔開鋼筋與水分及侵蝕介質，也決定鋼筋到受壓邊緣的有效深度。增加保護層可能改善耐久性，卻會縮短內力力臂，改變裂縫分布及彎曲容量。曲面襯砌中，鋼筋籠偏心及局部墊塊位移常使設計厚度無法直接代表有效深度，必須對照實測鋼筋位置與真正受拉側。~Cover separates reinforcement from water and aggressive agents while also determining the effective depth measured from the compression face. More cover can improve durability but reduce the internal lever arm and alter crack distribution and bending resistance. In a curved lining, cage eccentricity and displaced spacers mean nominal thickness does not establish effective depth. Measurements must identify actual bar position and the tension face for the relevant bending direction.
units.model: 原創教學假設：襯砌厚 h=500 mm、受拉側保護層 c=60 mm、主筋直徑φ=20 mm，d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For lining thickness h=500 mm, tension-face cover c=60 mm and bar diameter φ=20 mm, d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 澆置前量測籠位與墊塊，澆置後用校正的保護層探測器抽查，必要時採局部驗證。將實測偏差輸入截面分析，分別核對耐久下限及有效深度，不能只以平均保護層符合判定全段合格。~Survey cages and spacers before placement, then sample with a calibrated cover meter and justified local verification. Insert measured deviations into section analysis, separately checking minimum durability cover and effective depth; an acceptable average does not establish compliance everywhere.
units.failure: 保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。若探測器未校正而漏掉籠位偏移，竣工模型會高估局部抗彎能力與使用壽命。~Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks. An uncalibrated survey that misses cage displacement can overstate local flexural resistance and durability in the as-built model.
units.misconception: 保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。~Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking.
units.practice: 將保護層偏差與鋼筋位置保留在竣工斷面，而非只保存合格章；超差區由結構設計者評估受力和耐久兩項需求後核定處理。~Retain cover deviations and bar locations in as-built sections rather than only a compliance stamp; the structural designer evaluates both resistance and durability before deciding how to treat out-of-tolerance zones.

units.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證~Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。若永久設計依賴排水，堵塞、停電及管路隔離就屬重要的失效情境。監測必須區分外部水頭與井內水位，因為作用於襯砌的是兩側壓差，單看抽水機是否運轉無法證明壓差受到控制。~After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate. If the permanent design relies on drainage, blockage, power loss and pipe isolation become relevant failure scenarios. Monitoring must distinguish external head from the internal shaft water level because differential pressure loads the lining. Pump-running status alone does not establish control of that pressure difference.
units.model: 原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。只有壓差與結構反應均落在核定範圍，才可確認交接階段的水力邊界成立。~Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops. Compare drainage flow, crack readings and leak locations concurrently; the handover hydraulic boundary is demonstrated only when pressure differences and structural response satisfy approved criteria.
units.failure: 排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。先出現接縫滲漏不表示壓力已安全釋放，局部堵塞與壓力分區可能仍持續增加構件需求。~Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. Initial joint leakage does not prove safe pressure relief; local blockage and compartmentalized water can continue increasing lining demand.
units.misconception: 有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。~Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
units.practice: 維護圖應標明每段排水的集水範圍、可隔離閥及替代排水路徑；停抽或封閉排水前，由設計者及營運單位共同核准水頭回復監測計畫。~Maintenance drawings must identify each drainage catchment, isolation valve and alternative route; the designer and operator jointly approve a groundwater-recovery monitoring plan before pumping or drainage is discontinued.

units.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證~Crack growth rate mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 裂縫寬度是某一時刻的狀態，成長率與其對溫度及水頭的反應才有助區分持續變形和可逆開合。相同裂縫在不同季節量測可能有不同寬度，測點位置改變也會造成假趨勢。維護判讀需把裂縫位置、方向、滲水與材料劣化放在同一時間軸，避免把平穩表象誤認為已停止發展。~Crack width describes one state, while growth rate and response to temperature and water head help distinguish progressive deformation from reversible opening. Seasonal measurements can differ even without permanent damage, and changing gauge locations creates false trends. Maintenance interpretation therefore needs a common time axis for crack position, direction, leakage and material deterioration. An apparently stable isolated reading does not establish that the underlying movement has stopped.
units.model: 原創教學假設：固定測點裂縫由 w₀=0.20 mm增至w₁=0.30 mm，間隔Δt=2 year，平均成長率(w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: At a fixed point, width changes from w₀=0.20 mm to w₁=0.30 mm over Δt=2 year, giving mean growth (w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。當變化接近解析度時先報不確定度，避免把量測雜訊當成劣化趨勢。~Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading. Separate permanent increments at comparable conditions from short cycles; report uncertainty when changes approach resolution rather than treating noise as deterioration.
units.failure: 缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。若裂縫伴隨混濁滲水或新剝落，應追查接觸、滲流與腐蝕，而非僅重貼量測標記。~Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration. Cracking accompanied by turbid leakage or fresh spalling requires investigation of contact, seepage and corrosion rather than merely replacing measurement marks.
units.misconception: 裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。~A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
units.practice: 交接資料應含初始裂縫圖、環境基準與事件後檢查責任；異常成長或滲流改變由管理單位召集原設計專業判讀，不能只以年度平均率決定放行。~Handover must include initial crack maps, environmental baselines and responsibility for post-event inspections; abnormal growth or changed seepage requires engineering interpretation, and annual mean growth alone must not determine release.

example: 原創教學例：同一方向總應力假設為900 kPa，孔隙水壓為300 kPa，骨架有效應力為σ′=900−300=600 kPa。若只把孔壓提高10%至330 kPa，而總應力保持不變，σ′變為570 kPa，降低30 kPa亦即5%。這個比較只適用於相同位置、方向及總應力邊界；它不表示襯砌所受外水壓減少，相反水壓需求可能增加。工程師應分別把骨架強度與襯砌水壓作用帶回各自模型，並用分層水壓資料確認假設。~Original teaching example: assume total stress of 900 kPa and pore pressure of 300 kPa in the same direction, giving skeleton effective stress σ′=900−300=600 kPa. Increase only pore pressure by 10% to 330 kPa while holding total stress fixed: σ′ becomes 570 kPa, a reduction of 30 kPa or 5%. This comparison requires the same location, direction and total-stress boundary. It does not reduce external water pressure on the lining; hydraulic demand may instead rise. Check skeleton strength and lining pressure in their respective models and verify the assumptions using aquifer-specific piezometer data.
history: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1997年：美國陸軍工兵署發布岩石隧道與豎井工程手冊，建立公開工程參考；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2018年：香港發布岩洞工程指南第二版，整理岩洞規劃設計及施工實務。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1997: USACE publishes its rock-tunnel and shaft manual as a public engineering reference; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2018: CEDD publishes the second cavern-engineering guide covering planning, design and construction. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
